description: Start a same-URL A/B test (draft or live source). Rules → get_skill('verify') § A/B.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes, shown on the test card (≤120 chars).

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): dotsy finishes the test WITHOUT further user instruction — the LIVE SITE may change later on its own (a ≥95% winner is auto-promoted, old page kept as a draft; or after 30 days with no clear winner the test auto-ends keeping the control). Only set when the user explicitly asked for hands-off / auto-finish.
